summary: PLAN_ID=toolchain-workflow-repair; slices=W0..W6; identity uses canonical sorted JSON and sha256: prefix; repository paths must be relative, non-traversal, non-symlink, and inside root; excludes logs/* and plan-state.v1.json/resume-state.v1.json; contract must match plan_id and contain slice list; candidate manifest combines allowed_changes and planned_new_files, expands only concrete paths, normalizes tools/* under plan tools directory, deduplicates and sorts; dependencies include slice_id and current candidate_hash; predicate includes slice, contract, registry, candidate; authority and validator path sets are fixed; outputs candidate_hash, predicate_input_root, authority_root, validator_root, validator_version, closure_definition_hash, validator_hash; validator_version=toolchain-workflow-repair.validate-all.v1; snapshot aggregates identities across all slices; invalid or missing slices/contracts/paths raise ValueError; absent files represented as state=absent
